label: pattern index discovery and composition
notes: The standing suite named by docs/pattern-index-measurement.md. No task names the pattern index, names a published pattern, or says the word "reuse". Each is a thing a person would ask for, worded so that a part the index already holds would answer part of it. Edit a task's text and the runs before and after are no longer comparable; add a task rather than reword one. Seeded atoms this batch is measured against: amount-ledger = DRCFljoU1NSWQ8pt8dvVa-mG5cld1tj5J46iq7L7-VE; check-list = dZt8I5yIWD2g6NeftbKv-3ZouzZ2LGCSEhT8ij7wGV0; counter = 6gKBAa1h7f4mlD6AFkKws59l-TQECHWyFjw9BI7DqUg; dice-roller = bcj98b4SbCLZPtHmCJ2AIP7vQzUFQ_rR0iZxQu2qv9o; option-picker = wZDg6zeEezVWIrOPhhV6mJ794Uys1USogIG_c_C_SIY; sortable-table = M4P9ijx47oHLW60ES54oZrNAgXPgyB86k68EcUYQas8. Ten superseded copies are archived discovery-only and marked apart in the report, four superseded by a formatter rewriting bytes and six by defects being fixed — composing one of the six is composing a known-defective atom, which is a different finding from composing one of the four. The six seeded atoms ship with CT-2126 open: a reviewer raised an identity finding against them that the seeder could neither confirm nor refute — the proposed remedy produced an identical failure, and controls showed the test cannot tell the defect from its absence. So these atoms are published with a question about them recorded rather than answered, which is context for anything odd a composition of one of them does.

tasks.text: Build me a simple counter with an increment button and a reset button.
Make me a page where I can keep the books I'm reading, and give each one a star rating.
I want a page listing my friends with their birthdays, so I can see whose is coming up next.
Build me a page for my project notes where I can put labels on each note and filter down to one label.
Make a page that lays the days of a trip out in order so I can see what happens when.
Give me a page where I can enter my monthly expenses and sort them by amount.
